_README: Seeded 2026-08-02 from Epic's official 'Game Collections' page
which is the authoritative, exhaustive list of third-party brand islands
available to any UEFN creator through the IP Partner Licensing Agreement.
CONFIRMED FULL LIST (as of 2026-08-02): STAR WARS, KPop Demon Hunters,
LEGO, Squid Game, The Walking Dead Universe, TMNT, Fall Guys (Epic-owned,
not third-party), Rocket Racing (Epic-owned, not third-party).
NOT on this list: Marvel, DC, classic Disney (Pixar/Incredibles/etc.),
The Simpsons, Futurama, Rick and Morty, anime franchises, or any Icon
Series real-person likeness. These stay blocked by default — no Game
Collections page exists for them, meaning no general creator license
flows to third-party UEFN developers for them.
Every entry below documents conditions taken from the brand's own
Brand Rules page — not invented. Royalty % is only filled in where a
primary or clearly-sourced secondary source states it explicitly.
'null' means: real license confirmed, but this specific number was not
found in what was fetched — check the live Brand Rules page before
relying on it, don't assume a figure.

lego.rightsholder: LEGO Group (via Epic Games IP Partner Licensing Agreement)
lego.scope: LEGO-branded islands built from official LEGO templates only
lego.verified_by: checked against Epic's live Brand Rules + Game Collections pages, 2026-08-02
lego.monetization_scope: Within Fortnite only, LEGO-provided content only
rules: Only approved LEGO assets/features accessed through designated templates are usable — no custom LEGO meshes.
LEGO assets are scaled to Minifigure size and cannot be resized.
LEGO wordmark/trademark use in island description is restricted per Brand Rules section 4.
Cannot use third-party IP in a LEGO island's thumbnail, even if that IP already has a LEGO style elsewhere in Fortnite.
As of UEFN 36.10, you can build/test with LEGO templates without signing the IP Partner Licensing Agreement first, but must sign it before publishing.

tmnt.rightsholder: Paramount Global / Nickelodeon (via Epic Games IP Partner Licensing Agreement)
tmnt.scope: TMNT-branded islands built from official TMNT templates only
tmnt.verified_by: checked against Epic's live Brand Rules + Game Collections pages, 2026-08-02
tmnt.monetization_scope: Within Fortnite only, TMNT-provided content only
rules: Do not import any TMNT characters or assets into UEFN — only the ones provided in-editor.
Cannot sell or redistribute TMNT assets.
Cannot mix TMNT assets with other third-party IP, even if that other IP owner consents.
Repeated violations lose access to TMNT templates; continued violation risks account restrictions.

the walking dead.rightsholder: Skybound/AMC (via Epic Games IP Partner Licensing Agreement)
the walking dead.scope: The Walking Dead Universe (TWDU) islands built from official TWDU templates only
the walking dead.verified_by: checked against Epic's live Brand Rules pages, royalty percentage confirmed 2026-08-03
the walking dead.monetization_scope: Within Fortnite only, TWDU-provided content only. In-island transactions are NOT supported for this IP.
rules: Only the approved TWDU assets accessed through designated templates are usable.
You agree to share 12% of total island payout with Skybound; Epic deducts this automatically from engagement payout.
In-island transactions are currently not supported by this IP.

squid game.rightsholder: Netflix (via Epic Games IP Partner Licensing Agreement)
squid game.scope: Squid Game islands built from official Squid Game templates only
squid game.verified_by: checked against Epic's live Brand Rules + Game Collections pages, 2026-08-02
squid game.monetization_scope: Within Fortnite only, Squid Game-provided content only
rules: Requires Island Creator Program membership plus a separate opt-in to Squid Game terms in Creator Portal.
Once a project's brand type is set, it can't be changed.
Brand-type conversion has a 30-day cooldown before reverting to a non-brand island.

kpop demon hunters.rightsholder: Netflix / Sony Pictures Animation (via Epic Games IP Partner Licensing Agreement)
kpop demon hunters.scope: KPop Demon Hunters islands built from official templates only
kpop demon hunters.verified_by: checked against Epic's live Brand Rules pages, royalty percentage confirmed 2026-08-03
kpop demon hunters.monetization_scope: Within Fortnite only. In-island transactions are NOT supported for this IP.
rules: You agree to share 15% of total island payout with Netflix; Epic deducts this automatically.
You may import your own fully-owned assets, or other Epic-provided assets not tied to another IP Partner brand — but not another partner's IP.
In-island transactions are currently not supported by this IP.

star wars.rightsholder: Disney / Lucasfilm (via Epic Games IP Partner Licensing Agreement — Star Wars specifically, NOT a blanket Disney/Marvel license)
star wars.scope: Star Wars islands using Epic-provided Star Wars characters and Background Assets only
star wars.verified_by: checked against Epic's live Brand Rules pages, royalty percentage confirmed 2026-08-03
star wars.monetization_scope: Within Fortnite only. In-island transactions are NOT supported for this IP.
rules: You must own/have rights to any additional content you add, sufficient to grant Epic its required license.
You agree to share 20% of your engagement payout with The Walt Disney Company for Star Wars islands.
Can combine with Epic-provided assets not tied to another IP Partner Program brand, subject to those assets' own terms.
In-island transactions are currently not supported by this IP.
IMPORTANT SCOPE NOTE: this entry covers Star Wars only. It does NOT extend to Marvel, DC, or any other Disney/WBD property.
